{"id":1909446423,"question_id":3651,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1770314253,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"12 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1909446423/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Transformed Array","memory":"25.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> constructTransformedArray(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int>ans(n , 0);\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(nums[i] == 0) ans[i] = nums[i];\n            int k = nums[i] % n;\n            if(k < 0) k += n;\n            ans[i] = nums[(i + k) % n];\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"transformed-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1646}
